update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Data collection interval, in seconds. It does not change the ceph-exporter or MGR Prometheus module refresh rates.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

function_only.title: Function-only mode
function_only.description: Run only on-demand Functions, without creating charts or making periodic metric requests.

url.title: Dashboard URL
url.description: Base URL of the Ceph Dashboard API. Redirects from a standby to the active MGR are followed securely.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Deadline for one Dashboard operation, in seconds, including discovery, login, retries, and decoding. At least 0.5.

not_follow_redirects.title: Reject redirects
not_follow_redirects.description: Reject Dashboard redirects instead of following them to the active MGR.

allowed_redirect_origins.title: Trusted active-MGR origins
allowed_redirect_origins.description: Scheme and host origins that may receive credentials after active-MGR discovery. The configured URL's origin is always trusted.

vnode.title: Virtual node
vnode.description: Associates this once-per-cluster job with a Virtual Node. Functions stay attached to the physical Agent job.

username.title: Dashboard username
username.description: Username for the Ceph Dashboard JSON login, not HTTP basic authentication. Required with `password` unless a bearer token file is used.

password.title: Dashboard password
password.description: Password for the Ceph Dashboard JSON login. Required with `username` unless a bearer token file is used.

bearer_token_file.title: Bearer token file
bearer_token_file.description: Path to a bearer token file managed outside Netdata. It takes priority over username and password and is reread on every request.

osd_selector.title: OSD selector
osd_selector.description: Simple-pattern selector matched against `osd.<id>` or OSD UUID before the cap.

max_osds.title: Maximum OSDs
max_osds.description: Maximum selected OSDs with individual charts. If the selected set exceeds this operator policy, no per-OSD metrics are collected.

pool_selector.title: Pool selector
pool_selector.description: Simple-pattern selector matched against pool names before the cap.

max_pools.title: Maximum pools
max_pools.description: Maximum selected pools with individual charts. If the selected set exceeds this operator policy, no per-pool metrics are collected.

force_http2.title: Force HTTP/2
force_http2.description: Force HTTP/2, including h2c over plain TCP.

proxy_url.title: Proxy URL
proxy_url.description: HTTP proxy URL. Leave empty to use the proxy environment variables.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Additional HTTP headers. `Authorization`, `Cookie`, and `Host` are managed by the collector and rejected here.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate and hostname verification. Insecure; on by default only for self-signed Dashboard deployments.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Absolute path to a CA bundle used to validate the Dashboard certificate.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Absolute path to a client certificate for mTLS.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Absolute path to the client private key for mTLS.

bearer_token_file.ui:help: The token is sent only after credentialless active-MGR discovery and takes priority over Dashboard JSON login. Its external owner must replace it before expiry; the file is reread for every request.

vnode.ui:placeholder: Create a Virtual Node first, then reference its name here.

update_every.ui:help: This does not change the standalone ceph-exporter refresh (5 seconds by default on Reef 18 and later) or the MGR Prometheus module cache refresh (15 seconds by default).
